scope.excludes: All other models categories / scene assets

unsupported_shader_effects: Game shaders are not reproduced; GLB materials are a diffuse/normal PBR approximation.
Specular, cubemap/reflection, masks and additional texture units are not exported.
Shader parameters, material/vertex colors, blend states, emissive effects and procedural effects are not reproduced.
Transform sequences and animation are not exported; this is static geometry.

limitations.detail: No diffuse binding supplied for these parts. Source geometry retained; material colors/effects are not reconstructed, not a missing-texture substitute.
